# Shared editorial standards

Follow [the editorial contract](../../../docs/editorial-contract.md).

1. Preserve meaning, author decisions and the actual requested format.
2. Distinguish supported factual claims, recollections, opinions and inferences.
3. Research only claims needing verification; no fabricated citations or metrics.
4. Prefer clarity and useful specificity without flattening distinctive voice.
5. Apply private style and readability preferences only when accessible and relevant.

There is no universal banned-word list, grade target, mandatory first-person persona, no-bullet rule or required sentence length. Do not treat a stylistic preference as a safety or factual blocker.
